maria_p: FYI customer "LedgerOne" asked for a contractual burst product that avoids full dedicated warm pools. They want deterministic minutes and clear credits for unmet burst minutes. We need a narrow pilot plan.

samir_eng: Two feasible primitives: (1) short-lease slots (router acquires lease for N seconds), or (2) token-bucket of prepaid burst-minutes consumed atomically. Leases give low-latency claims; token-buckets are simpler to bill.

jo_cse: Customer needs live visibility in Console (minutes remaining, recent fallbacks). Also want a playbook for oncall.

diane_sre: Ops: leases add GC and churn; token-bucket needs strong atomic decrement under peak QPS. Observability: add metrics reserve_claim_latency_ms, reserve_fallback_rate, reserve_minutes_remaining. Alert: fallback_rate>0.5% for 10m.

ellen_legal: Contract suggestion: "Guaranteed Burst Minutes: Redwood will make commercially reasonable efforts to honor reserved burst minutes. If Redwood cannot honor reserved burst minutes due to platform constraints, Redwood will issue credits at a multiplier capped at 2x per unmet minute." Legal insists on 'commercially reasonable' to limit force-majeure exposure.

alex_sales: I'll prototype a one-pager: token-bucket pilot + Console widget + 30d trial. Pricing: premium per-minute + credit multiplier.

samir_eng: Pilot scope (minimal): credit-ledger per-region, router claim check (atomic decrement), fallback marker emit, simple Console panel. Acceptance criteria: 1) claim_p95 < 250ms during pilot spikes; 2) no double-allocs in chaos tests; 3) billing markers accurate. Rough estimate: 6 eng-weeks across runtime/router/console.

maria_p: Blockers: legal wording, billing export changes, ops capacity for prewarm. Action items:
- samir: RFC sketch + perf test plan by Wed
- diane: runbook skeleton + initial alerts by Thu
- alex: term sheet draft + pricing sketch by Thu
- jo: pilot test cases + acceptance checklist by Fri
autosc ale-bot: pilot ticket created: `pilot/3301234567-tokenbucket-burst` (status: open)

maria_p: Keep scope tight for pilot; we'll evaluate warm-pool if utilization delta justifies it.
